title: Soy Chicken Rice Bowl with Lentils
blurb: Tender grilled chicken on a bed of rice and lentils, dressed with soy sauce and scattered with fresh parsley and spring onions.
steps: Put the rice in a pan with 400ml water and bring to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Meanwhile, cook the lentils in boiling water for 12 minutes until tender, then drain well.
Brush the chicken breasts with half the olive oil and season with black pepper.
Heat a griddle pan over high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 7 minutes each side until cooked through and charred, then slice into strips.
Finely slice the spring onions and chop the parsley.
Mix the cooked rice and lentils together in a large bowl with the remaining olive oil and the soy sauce.
Divide the rice mixture between four bowls, top with the sliced chicken and scatter over the spring onions and parsley.
